validationPolicy: User owns visual review. Unit tests and behavioral E2E only; no screenshot acceptance or per-pixel comparison.
checks: 2D native opacity previews without changing Project content or its version
Disabling preview restores applied opacity; Apply followed by another preview and Cancel keeps the applied value
One Undo restores the pre-Apply value
External same-layer changes invalidate the stale preview; Cancel retains the external value
3D native visibility previews without changing Project content or version
3D Apply followed by another preview and Cancel restores the latest applied visibility; one Undo restores the original
Actual GLB matrix position changes to 100 m and restores to its applied anchor on Cancel
Water runtime height changes to 40 m and restores on Cancel
GLB is requested once during preview and rollback
coverageBoundary: Behavior and runtime-state evidence; visual review is delegated to the user. Native desktop and Windows scaling acceptance remain separate.
remaining: Full specialized field coverage and native acceptance; resource replacement remains an Apply-time operation.
